decisions.reason: The necessary size-related impact is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting the policy to exclude the bundled video and stream it from YouTube.
Changing the how-to video's delivery to YouTube streaming does not alter Android translation coverage or language requirements.
Changing the how-to video's delivery to YouTube streaming does not alter iOS translation coverage or language requirements.
The streaming decision does not necessarily change the Android API level, deprecated-API refactoring, or dependency-modernization requirements.
The video-delivery decision has no effect on the requirement to remove unused sensitive Android permissions.
